description: This file defines CLI commands for managing channels in Mattermost, including creating, renaming, archiving, deleting, listing, modifying privacy, unarchiving, searching, and moving channels. It uses Cobra for command structure and interacts with Mattermost API via client methods.

methods.name: createChannelCmdF
methods.description: Creates a new channel with specified parameters such as name, display name, team, header, purpose, and privacy setting.

methods.name: archiveChannelsCmdF
methods.description: Archives specified channels by their identifiers.

methods.name: getAllPublicChannelsForTeam
methods.description: Retrieves all public channels for a given team, paginated.

methods.name: getAllDeletedChannelsForTeam
methods.description: Retrieves all deleted (archived) channels for a team, paginated.

methods.name: listChannelsCmdF
methods.description: Lists all channels (public, private, archived) for specified teams.

methods.name: modifyChannelCmdF
methods.description: Modifies the privacy setting of a channel (public/private).

methods.name: renameChannelCmdF
methods.description: Renames a channel and/or updates its display name.

methods.name: searchChannelCmdF
methods.description: Searches for a channel by name, optionally within a specific team.

methods.name: moveChannelCmdF
methods.description: Moves channels to a different team, validating team membership.
